name: convex
description: Convex helps users build and scale JavaScript and TypeScript apps with a reactive, type-safe backend. The app gives ChatGPT concrete Convex setup guidance for new projects, existing frontend integrations, production scaling questions, and the bundled Convex quickstart runbook so agents follow the current deployment, auth, and component patterns instead of hand-rolling from stale memory.
